searchText: So we have had success in resynching holesky nodes to the latest block, but once we got in synch we are seeing constant restarts. Is anyone else seeing this issue and if so how were you able to resolve it? which version of prysm are you trying? and we've had good success with lighthouse(use beta.0 release) or teku(use latest develop) for e.g. I'm looking at https://light-holesky.beaconcha.in/epoch/115968, and I'm seeing inconsistencies on whether slot `3710976` was missed or not. One view says it was, and the other says it was not. FWIW my beacon node says it was not but just wanted to cross-check here likely a bug there! We’re running the holesky-blacklist version. Is there a more stable version for us to pick up?
